tip.title: HOW TO PLAY
tip.1: 1. Put chips on the table: arrows and {x}, or the mouse.
tip.2: 2. Send any prompt in Claude Code: the wheel spins while Claude thinks. There is no spin button.
tip.2demo: 2. In this demo the wheel spins by itself. For real, every prompt you send in Claude Code is a spin.
tip.3: 3. When Claude finishes, the ball drops. No new bet? Your last one plays again.
